I was hoping to get a fresh pair, same kind and everything. Also, I got a jigsaw puzzle, but I think I want to swap it for one with a fancier design and, like, 500 fewer pieces, but still just as tricky. Can you help me out?
Oh, I totally blanked on the email I used—sorry! But my name is Yara Ito and my zip code is 75284. Will that work?

Oh, I don’t have the order ID handy—my packing slip is somewhere in the mess on my table. If you could check my recent orders, that would be awesome! The boots are brown and the puzzle has a mountain scene, if that helps.

Thanks for pulling that up! Yes, please go ahead and exchange both the boots and the puzzle for me. For the puzzle, I think the 1000-piece fantasy theme with intermediate difficulty sounds perfect—fancy and not too many pieces! And yep, using my original PayPal is totally fine for any price difference. Let’s do it!
Yep, that covers everything I wanted to swap! Go ahead and process the exchanges, please. Thanks so much for your help!
That’s awesome, thank you! I’ll keep an eye out for the email and get those returns sorted. Appreciate your help—have a great day! ###STOP###
